title: Auroracrest Axe
body:
The Auroracrest Axe is a unique axe and the only tool capable of chopping Boreal Trees.

Details

The Axe is obtained through crafting by fusing a Heart of Borealis and an Icecrest Axe on a special altar located within the Snowlands, while an aurora event is occurring.

This Axe has a unique ability due to its nature of being made from a Icecrest Axe it is unable to chop any wood aside from Boreal.

Obtaining

Note: The Auroracrest Axe will not transform if it is not an aurora event.

  • Gather the two materials needed • The Icecrest Axe can be bought from the Ice Golem Shop for $24,000. • The Heart of Borealis can be found in the Snowlands during a Aurora event .

With the materials acquired, proceed to the next step. For people who prefer a video guide, follow along with this Youtube Video.
